product_from_film: Saperly presents a phone carrier and phone identity for AI agents so they can reach services that require calls.
explains_well: A table reservation and flower order show why an agent that can find information still needs a phone connection.
unclear: The film ends at the service promise without showing an agent getting a number, placing a call or completing either blocked task.
scenario: Let an agent call a restaurant or flower shop to complete a request.
product_clear_basis: End cards explicitly name Saperly as a phone carrier built for AI agents.
